summary: Park County, CO tower in Pike National Forest: a 40' steel tower built in 1954 and taken down in 1973. No source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.status_note: Taken down in 1973 per the FFLOS description; Forest Lookouts and FFA lists also mark it removed

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: lat/lon and elevation match the FFLOS detail page; no corrections. The FFA list gives 39.04917, -105.51278, about 30 m from the FFLOS point. Build and removal years rest on one FFLOS description; the other two sources say only removed. No staffing, fire, access or remains information in the sources read, so those keys are left out. The 1958 FFLOS photo has no image URL in our cache, so it is not in photos. Wikipedia's peak article was not used.
